vocabulary.meaning_en: something you do regularly, often without thinking
vocabulary.example: Getting up early is a good habit.
We visit our grandparents on a regular basis.

vocabulary.meaning_en: neat, with everything in its place
vocabulary.example: Adam is not a tidy boy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way
vocabulary.note_ar: have an inclination to = لديه ميل إلى
vocabulary.example: I have an inclination to talk too quickly.
He's inclined to go on a bit too long.
As a rule, I go to bed before eleven.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be likely to suffer from or do something (often bad)
vocabulary.example: I'm prone to colds in winter.
I tend to get tired in the afternoon.

vocabulary.meaning_ar: في أغلب الأحيان (تسع مرات من عشر)
vocabulary.example: Nine times out of ten, he's home by six.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (with continuous tenses) very often, in an annoying way
vocabulary.note_ar: مع الأزمنة المستمرة تعني التكرار المزعج
vocabulary.note_en: With continuous tenses it means annoyingly often.
vocabulary.example: I was forever forgetting my homework.

vocabulary.meaning_en: do something that makes a person in charge angry with you
vocabulary.example: I was always getting into trouble at school.

fine_lines.title: used to vs would (past habits)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: للعادات المتكررة في الماضي يمكن استخدام used to أو would بنفس المعنى. لكن للحالات والحقائق (وليس العادات) نستخدم used to فقط: I used to work in a bank ✓، I would work in a bank ✗.
fine_lines.explanation_en: For repeated past actions, "used to" and "would" mean the same. For past states or facts (not habits), use only "used to": I used to work in a bank ✓; I would work in a bank ✗.

examples.sentence: I used to work in a bank.
I would visit my grandmother every Saturday.

fine_lines.title: Present simple vs always + -ing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط يصف عادة بشكل محايد. أما always + الفعل بـ ing (المضارع المستمر) فيصف عادة متكررة مزعجة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: The present simple describes a habit neutrally. "Always + -ing" (present continuous) describes a repeated habit that annoys you.

examples.sentence: Dad takes us to school every day.
He's always leaving his things on the floor.

expressions.phrase: She'll always tell you what's on her mind.
expressions.meaning_ar: ستخبرك دائمًا بما يدور في ذهنها.
expressions.meaning_en: Uses will to describe a typical habit.
expressions.example: My aunt is very honest. She'll always tell you what's on her mind.
He's always leaving things lying around.

expressions.meaning_ar: شخص ما يستمر في الاتصال بي.
expressions.meaning_en: Describes something that happens again and again.
expressions.example: An unknown number keeps calling me.

expressions.meaning_en: Describes one of your own habits, often a weakness.
expressions.example: I have an inclination to speak too quickly.
I'm inclined to go on a bit too long.
As a rule, I get up at six o'clock.

expressions.meaning_en: Says something bad often happens to you.
expressions.example: I'm prone to headaches when I don't sleep.
I tend to get a cold when the weather changes.
Nine times out of ten, he watches the match after dinner.

expressions.phrase: I used to ... when I was young.
expressions.meaning_en: Describes a past habit that has stopped.
expressions.example: I used to play football every Saturday when I was young.

expressions.meaning_en: Describes a habit that continued in the past.
expressions.example: My grandfather kept on reading books well into his nineties.

expressions.phrase: I was always getting into trouble.
expressions.example: I was always getting into trouble with my maths teacher.

expressions.meaning_en: Describes a past habit that happened very often.
expressions.example: I was forever forgetting my history project.

grammar.title: Present habits
grammar.explanation_ar: للعادات الحالية نستخدم: المضارع البسيط (Mum prepares lunch every day)، will + الفعل (She'll disagree with everything)، always + ing للعادة المزعجة، keep (on) + ing، وعبارات مثل as a rule / tend to / be prone to / nine times out of ten.
grammar.explanation_en: For present habits use: the present simple (Mum prepares lunch every day); will + verb (She'll disagree with everything); always + -ing for annoying habits; keep (on) + -ing; and phrases like as a rule / tend to / be prone to / nine times out of ten.
examples: Dad takes us to school every day.
She'll disagree with everything you say.

grammar.title: Past habits
grammar.explanation_ar: للعادات الماضية نستخدم: used to + الفعل، would + الفعل (للأفعال المتكررة فقط)، kept (on) + ing، was always / was forever + ing، وwas prone to.
grammar.explanation_en: For past habits use: used to + verb; would + verb (only for repeated actions); kept (on) + -ing; was always / was forever + -ing; and was prone to.
examples: I used to visit my grandmother every Saturday.
I would visit my grandmother every Saturday.
I kept on eating pizza, even though the doctor told me not to.

grammar.title: keep / tend / be prone: verb patterns
grammar.explanation_ar: keep (on) + ing. tend to + الفعل. be prone to + اسم أو فعل (to هنا قد تكون حرف جر: prone to getting / prone to colds). be inclined to + الفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: keep (on) + -ing; tend to + verb; be inclined to + verb; be prone to + noun (or -ing, e.g. prone to colds / prone to getting sick).
examples: He keeps on forgetting his keys.
I tend to eat too fast.
I'm prone to colds in winter.

questions.question: Which sentence describes an ANNOYING habit?
choices: He's always leaving his socks on the floor.

questions.question: Which sentence is WRONG?
choices: I used to work in a bank.
I would visit my grandmother on Saturdays.
I would work in a bank (as a fact about my past job).
questions.explanation_ar: لا نستخدم would للحالات والحقائق الماضية، بل used to فقط.
questions.explanation_en: We don't use "would" for past states or facts; use "used to".

questions.question: "As a rule, I go to bed early" means:
choices: I usually go to bed early.
I never go to bed early.
I went to bed early once.

questions.question: I tend ___ tired in the afternoon.
My grandfather kept on ___ books into his nineties.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد kept on نستخدم الفعل بـ ing.

questions.question: Which tense do we USUALLY use for present habits?
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط هو الأكثر استخدامًا للعادات.
questions.explanation_en: The present simple is the usual tense for habits.

questions.question: When I was a child, I was ___ forgetting my homework.
questions.explanation_ar: was forever + ing لعادة ماضية متكررة.
questions.explanation_en: "was forever + -ing" for a frequent past habit.
